The answer: Mathlib was created in July 2017 during Big Proof, in Lean 3. Sources: leodemoura.github.io slide says "Created in July 2017, in Lean 3 during Big Proof." Wikipedia says 2017.

I'll give a short answer with URL.

content.text:
**2017 年**（具体是 2017 年 7 月，在“Big Proof”项目期间、基于 Lean 3 创建）。

依据：Leonardo de Moura 的演讲材料写明 “Mathlib: The Lean Mathematical Library — Created in July 2017, in Lean 3 during Big Proof.”（https://leodemoura.github.io/static/floc26/ ）；维基百科亦记载“2017年，Lean社群创立 mathlib 函数库”（https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/User:Yinweichen/Testpage1 ）。
